name: 12-get-state
description: GET /state returns the envelope tee-node decodes as its TeeState: a bytes32 stateVersion and the state as bytes. Both are empty on purpose — the zero version and no bytes — which tee-node carries as such and the registry accepts: the extension is registered without a state verifier. The extension publishes nothing here: its account of itself is the signed GET_READINESS report. A whole-body exact match, so a field carrying a price, a counter, a supply or a reserve figure can never reappear on this world-readable surface unnoticed.
